specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Single isolated 3D asset reference for a grounded, subtly stylized top-down extraction game, old civilian industrial maintenance district. Neutral plain light gray studio background, diffuse even lighting, full object in elevated three-quarter view, no cropping. Subject: ONE wall-attached loading dock BASE ONLY, intended about 5m wide, 2.5m deep, 1m high. Heavy weathered concrete rectangular platform with a recessed steel dock leveler flush with the top, two thick rubber bumpers on the front, one short broad three-step stair integrated at the right end. Broken beveled concrete corners expose a little aggregate; patchy faded yellow safety edge, rust only around steel seams. Rear edge perfectly straight and bare for attachment to a building; no rear wall. Solid grounded construction readable from above, plausible human-scale industrial proportions. Real materials and medium-scale detail, not Minecraft, not exaggerated cartoon, no black outlines. No canopy, roof, fence, vehicle, boxes, people, letters, logos, background building, huge ground plane or multiple assets. One coherent modular dock only.

Use case: stylized-concept. Single isolated 3D game asset reference, old civilian industrial maintenance building, grounded realistic materials suitable for restrained cartoon rendering. Neutral plain gray studio background, soft diffuse light, elevated three-quarter view showing roof top, front and side; entire object visible. ONE wall-mounted cantilever loading canopy assembly, 5m wide by 2.5m projection, about 1m structural height. Slightly sloping corrugated galvanized roof with broad bent front fascia and gutter, three substantial triangular steel wall brackets and a strong straight horizontal mounting rail across the rear. Brackets project under the roof, attached to rear rail; no support legs and no wall. Roof asymmetry comes from a slightly offset short vent hump on one end and one repaired roof strip. Slate gray steel, localized rust at seams, muted old teal on brackets. Thick believable folded edges, clear 3D depth, clean attachment plane. No floor, building, carport legs, stairs, vehicle, people, text, logos, extra loose props or scenery. A single reusable architectural add-on; open underside; no paper-thin geometry.

Use case: stylized-concept. Single isolated 3D game asset reference for an abandoned civilian repair district, realistic worn industrial materials compatible with restrained cartoon lighting. Neutral light gray studio background, evenly lit, complete object in elevated three-quarter view. ONE old vertical cylindrical galvanized rooftop service water tank assembly, about 2.5m diameter and 3.3m overall height on a short sturdy steel cradle with four squat feet. Shallow conical cap, a large closed inspection hatch offset on top, three circumferential reinforcing bands, one substantial exterior downpipe ending in an elbow just above the floor, short integrated inspection ladder running up one side. Faded off-white tank paint, muted dark teal support frame, localized reddish rust down joints; seams and dented panels, not uniform dirt. Strong readable rooftop silhouette, realistic wall thickness and connection points. No building, roof plane, people, labels, words, logos, terrain, scattered props or second tank. Tank and its support constitute one connected object, no open liquid or floating parts.

Use case: stylized-concept. One isolated heavy industrial machine awaiting repair, grounded realistic worn materials for a top-down extraction game, restrained cartoon-compatible forms. Neutral gray studio background and diffuse lighting, full object elevated three-quarter view. Large horizontal civilian turbine compressor cartridge about5m long by2.5m wide and2.1m tall supported on one sturdy low rusted steel transport cradle.
